[Act: income-tax-1961
 Chapter: Procedure for Assessment
 Section: 147A::Assessing Officer for purposes of sections 148 and 148A.
]


Notwithstanding anything contained in any judgment, order or decree of any court or in section 151A or in any scheme framed thereunder, for the removal of doubts, it is hereby clarified that the Assessing Officer for the purposes of sections 148 and 148A shall mean and shall always be deemed to have
meant to be an Assessing Officer other than the National Faceless Assessment Centre or any assessment unit referred to in sub-section (3) of section 144B.]

metadata.section_title: Assessing Officer for purposes of sections 148 and 148A.
